how_to_apply: Before applying, ensure you fulfil all eligibility criteria as mentioned in the detailed advertisement at drdo.gov.in.
B.E./B.Tech/Diploma candidates: Register on the NATS 2.0 portal at nats.education.gov.in (mandatory).
Log in to NATS 2.0 and apply by selecting Research Centre Imarat, DRDO – Enrolment ID: STLRAC000010.
ITI Trade candidates: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (mandatory).
Log in, click "Apprenticeship Opportunities," search by Establishment Name "RESEARCH CENTRE IMARAT" (Establishment ID: E05203600040), choose your trade, and click Apply.
Submit the application within 30 days of the advertisement's publication in a newspaper.

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 50* Graduate Apprentice 30* Technician (Diploma) Apprentice 115* Trade Apprentice (ITI) *Vacancies may vary. The official notification does not provide a trade-wise or discipline-wise split within each category, nor a category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) reservation table – it only states that reservation will apply "as per provisions of the Apprentices Act 1961, Apprentice Rules 1992, and Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules 2019 & 2025."

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Instrumentation Engg., Electrical & Electronics (EEE), Computer Science (CSE), Mechanical, Chemical Engg., Metallurgical Engg., Safety Engg., Aeronautical Engg., Aerospace Engg., or Civil Engg.
Diploma in ECE, Instrumentation Engg., EEE, CSE, Mechanical, Chemical Engg., Metallurgical Engg., or Safety Engg.
ITI pass-out in Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Mechanic-Diesel, Electronic-Mechanic, Electrician, COPA (Computer Operator & Programming Assistant), Draughtsman (Mechanical), or Grinder

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Educational qualification as per the category applied for (see vacancy table above), from an Indian Institution recognized by the appropriate statutory authority Only regular candidates who secured 70% marks or CGPA 7.5 and above in the qualifying examination (Graduate, Diploma, or ITI trade) for the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible to apply Candidates with a higher qualification than that prescribed for the category are not eligible to apply Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship training under any organisation are not eligible Candidates with more than 1 year of work experience are not eligible Indian nationality required

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: Candidate should not be less than 18 years as on 01 September 2026 . Not specified in the official notification: any upper age limit.

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend is paid as per Government norms (referenced to the Gazette Notification dated 03 September 2025 ) – the notification does not state the exact monthly stipend figures for each category. For Graduate and Technician (Diploma) Apprentices, it is mandatory to have an Aadhaar-seeded/linked bank account, as 50% of the stipend is paid by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme.

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on Academic Merit / Interview as required, subject to satisfactory document verification – there is no written test Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/EWS categories applies as per the Apprentices Act 1961, Apprentice Rules 1992, and the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules 2019 & 2025 Shortlisted candidates are informed only via the e-mail ID given in the application; candidates must keep it active throughout the selection process, as RCI is not responsible for non-receipt of communication due to a changed mobile number/e-mail Before commencement of training, selected candidates must execute a contract of apprenticeship on the respective portal (NATS/NAPS) Selected candidates must produce a valid Police Verification Certificate (from their place of last residence for at least 1 year, or permanent address) at the time of joining Not specified in the official notification: the exact academic-merit weightage formula, interview marks, or shortlisting ratio.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027
content_sections.text: Important: Portal registration (NATS 2.0 or Apprenticeship India, as applicable to your category) is mandatory before applying. There is no separate offline or e-mail application route described for the main application itself.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (At Document Verification/Joining)
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form NATS/NAPS profile printout 10th class mark sheet and certificate Consolidated/final mark sheet of the qualifying examination Original/provisional certificate of the qualifying examination Caste certificate, if applicable PwD certificate, if applicable Valid EWS certificate, if applicable Any photo ID issued by Govt. of India (PAN Card/Voter ID/Driving Licence) Aadhaar Card (mandatory) Copy of Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook/statement (mandatory, Aadhaar-linked account required) Medical fitness certificate issued by a Government Civil Assistant Surgeon Two latest passport-size photographs All documents must be carried in original and self-attested copy .

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Document verification is done for shortlisted candidates only, prior to creation of the apprenticeship contract; any deviation from the desired qualification leads to rejection All qualifications must be from Indian Institutions recognized by the appropriate statutory authority Suppression of facts leads to disqualification at any stage of selection or during the apprenticeship period No TA/DA is paid to applicants called for any stage of the selection process Apprentices are not provided hostel accommodation, quarters, or transport by RCI, either during interview or during the apprenticeship period The engagement and training strictly follow the Apprentices Act 1961; there is no obligation for employment on completion of training Canvassing or personal follow-up for selection leads to immediate cancellation of candidature RCI reserves the right to terminate apprenticeship, or to amend/refix/cancel/suspend the selection process at any time, without assigning any reason; the Management's decision is final and binding, with no appeal entertained Selected candidates will not be allowed to withdraw from training except for reasons beyond their control, and must execute an apprenticeship contract on the respective portal before training begins Any legal dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court, Hyderabad, Telangana

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice vacancies are notified by RCI?
faq.answer: 195 vacancies (tentative) – 50 Graduate Apprentice, 30 Technician (Diploma) Apprentice, and 115 Trade Apprentice (ITI).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 30 days from the date this advertisement is published in a newspaper (ie 01November 2026)

faq.question: Q3. What percentage of marks is required?
faq.answer: 70% marks or CGPA 7.5 and above in the qualifying examination (Graduate, Diploma, or ITI), passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech/Diploma candidates apply via NATS 2.0 (nats.education.gov.in); ITI trade candidates apply via Apprenticeship India (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum age?
faq.answer: 18 years as on 1 September 2026; no upper age limit is specified.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on academic merit and/or interview, subject to document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: Stipend is paid as per Government norms (per the Gazette Notification dated 3 September 2025); exact figures are not stated in this notification.

faq.question: Q8. Does this apprenticeship lead to a job at DRDO/RCI?
faq.answer: No. The engagement follows the Apprentices Act, 1961, and there is no obligation of employment on completion of training.
